text_block_list.text:
Just as morning classes are about to
start...

Wait! Wait for meee! Don't close the
gate!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... Did I make it? Whew! I made it!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: No, I'm not okay! Because both of my...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I have two alarm clocks that I set every
night, and
somehow, both of their
batteries died at the same
time!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
They say to always have a spare, but I
think my
spare needs a spare! And I'll
need to verify all
three are working
before going to sleep every―
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Right, thanks! Urk! Maybe I can still
make it in
time!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Her usual grace and wisdom seemingly
gone, Biwa
Hayahide runs toward the
school building with her
wild locks
trailing behind her like a comet tail.
